title.narrative: Projet de valorisation de la biomasse pour une amélioration de la résilience

description.narrative: Farmers, particularly women, are increasingly vulnerable to the adverse effects of climate change. They are facing a number of difficulties, including the proliferation of plastic bags, which is causing soil aridity and, above all, lower yields. In the village of Gampèla, women and girls have got into the habit of cutting wood to generate income, but also and above all for domestic energy (cooking, heating, etc.). Wood energy is the most widely used fuel in Burkinabe households, as they have difficulty finding cleaner, sustainable fuels to meet their energy needs. The women of the La Saisonnière association, particularly the most vulnerable, experience these difficulties on a daily basis. This project has been developed with a view to improving women's resilience to the harmful effects of climate change through the use of biomass. The project aims to develop innovative alternatives for meeting agricultural input and cooking energy needs. It is a green response to help vulnerable women adapt to climate change, and will help protect the environment and increase the financial capacity of village women, including internally displaced persons. Beneficiaries will receive several training sessions on the production and use of biofertilisers and biochar, as well as production equipment and advice.
